package utils
import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"github.com/a-h/templ"
	twmerge "github.com/Oudwins/tailwind-merge-go"
)
var (
	twV4Var = regexp.MustCompile(`-\((--[A-Za-z0-9-]+)\)`)
	twV3Var = regexp.MustCompile(`-\[var\((--[A-Za-z0-9-]+)\)\]`)
)
func lastTopLevelColon(s string) int {
	depth, last := 0, -1
	for i, r := range s {
		switch r {
		case '[':
			depth++
		case ']':
			depth--
		case ':':
			if depth == 0 {
				last = i
			}
		}
	}
	return last
}
func twImportantToV3(token string) string {
	if !strings.HasSuffix(token, "!") {
		return token
	}
	base := strings.TrimSuffix(token, "!")
	i := lastTopLevelColon(base)
	return base[:i+1] + "!" + base[i+1:]
}
func twImportantToV4(token string) string {
	i := lastTopLevelColon(token)
	if i+1 >= len(token) || token[i+1] != '!' {
		return token
	}
	return token[:i+1] + token[i+2:] + "!"
}
func twMapTokens(s string, f func(string) string) string {
	if !strings.Contains(s, "!") {
		return s
	}
	tokens := strings.Fields(s)
	for i, t := range tokens {
		tokens[i] = f(t)
	}
	return strings.Join(tokens, " ")
}
func twReorder(input, merged string) string {
	survivors := strings.Fields(merged)
	if len(survivors) < 2 {
		return merged
	}
	remaining := make(map[string]int, len(survivors))
	for _, c := range survivors {
		remaining[c]++
	}
	ordered := make([]string, 0, len(survivors))
	tokens := strings.Fields(input)
	for i := len(tokens) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if remaining[tokens[i]] == 0 {
			continue
		}
		remaining[tokens[i]]--
		ordered = append(ordered, tokens[i])
	}
	if len(ordered) != len(survivors) {
		return merged
	}
	slices.Reverse(ordered)
	return strings.Join(ordered, " ")
}
func CN(classes ...any) string {
	flat := flattenClasses(classes)
	merged := make([]string, len(flat))
	for i, c := range flat {
		merged[i] = twMapTokens(twV4Var.ReplaceAllString(c, "-[var($1)]"), twImportantToV3)
	}
	input := strings.Join(merged, " ")
	out := twMapTokens(twReorder(input, twmerge.Merge(merged...)), twImportantToV4)
	return twV3Var.ReplaceAllString(out, "-($1)")
}
func flattenClasses(values []any) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, v := range values {
		switch t := v.(type) {
		case nil:
		case string:
			if t != "" {
				out = append(out, t)
			}
		case []string:
			for _, c := range t {
				if c != "" {
					out = append(out, c)
				}
			}
		case []any:
			out = append(out, flattenClasses(t)...)
		case map[string]bool:
			keys := make([]string, 0, len(t))
			for c, on := range t {
				if on && c != "" {
					keys = append(keys, c)
				}
			}
			slices.Sort(keys)
			out = append(out, keys...)
		}
	}
	return out
}
func Ptr[T any](v T) *T {
	return &v
}
func IfElse[T any](condition bool, trueValue T, falseValue T) T {
	if condition {
		return trueValue
	}
	return falseValue
}
func Map[T, U any](s []T, f func(T) U) []U {
	out := make([]U, len(s))
	for i, v := range s {
		out[i] = f(v)
	}
	return out
}
func MergeAttributes(attrs ...templ.Attributes) templ.Attributes {
	merged := templ.Attributes{}
	for _, attr := range attrs {
		for k, v := range attr {
			merged[k] = v
		}
	}
	return merged
}
type directionKey struct{}
func WithDirection(ctx context.Context, direction string) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, directionKey{}, direction)
}
func Direction(ctx context.Context) string {
	if direction, ok := ctx.Value(directionKey{}).(string); ok && direction != "" {
		return direction
	}
	return "ltr"
}
func DirectionAttributes(ctx context.Context) templ.Attributes {
	if direction, ok := ctx.Value(directionKey{}).(string); ok && direction != "" {
		return templ.Attributes{"data-templ-direction": direction}
	}
	return templ.Attributes{}
}
func RandomID() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("id-%s", rand.Text())
}
var ScriptVersion = fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().Unix())
var ScriptURL = func(path string) string {
	return path + "?v=" + ScriptVersion
}

package security
import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/base64"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/argon2"
)
const (
	argonMemory      uint32 = 19 * 1024
	argonIterations  uint32 = 2
	argonParallelism uint8  = 1
	argonSaltLength         = 16
	argonKeyLength          = 32
	maxPasswordBytes = 1024
)
var (
	ErrEmptyPassword   = errors.New("password cannot be empty")
	ErrPasswordTooLong = errors.New("password exceeds maximum length")
	ErrInvalidHash     = errors.New("invalid password hash")
)
func HashPassword(password string) (string, error) {
	if password == "" {
		return "", ErrEmptyPassword
	}
	if len(password) > maxPasswordBytes {
		return "", ErrPasswordTooLong
	}
	salt := make([]byte, argonSaltLength)
	if _, err := rand.Read(salt); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("generate password salt: %w", err)
	}
	hash := argon2.IDKey(
		[]byte(password),
		salt,
		argonIterations,
		argonMemory,
		argonParallelism,
		argonKeyLength,
	)
	encodedSalt := base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(salt)
	encodedHash := base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(hash)
	encoded := fmt.Sprintf(
		"$argon2id$v=19$m=%d,t=%d,p=%d$%s$%s",
		argonMemory,
		argonIterations,
		argonParallelism,
		encodedSalt,
		encodedHash,
	)
	return encoded, nil
}
func VerifyPassword(password, encodedHash string) (bool, error) {
	if password == "" {
		return false, ErrEmptyPassword
	}
	if len(password) > maxPasswordBytes {
		return false, ErrPasswordTooLong
	}
	parts := strings.Split(encodedHash, "$")
	if len(parts) != 6 ||
		parts[0] != "" ||
		parts[1] != "argon2id" ||
		parts[2] != "v=19" ||
		parts[3] != "m=19456,t=2,p=1" {
		return false, ErrInvalidHash
	}
	salt, err := base64.RawStdEncoding.DecodeString(parts[4])
	if err != nil || len(salt) != argonSaltLength {
		return false, ErrInvalidHash
	}
	expectedHash, err := base64.RawStdEncoding.DecodeString(parts[5])
	if err != nil || len(expectedHash) != argonKeyLength {
		return false, ErrInvalidHash
	}
	actualHash := argon2.IDKey(
		[]byte(password),
		salt,
		argonIterations,
		argonMemory,
		argonParallelism,
		argonKeyLength,
	)
	matches := subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(actualHash, expectedHash) == 1
	return matches, nil
}

package security_test
import (
	"testing"
	"time"
	"shared/security"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)
func TestPasswordHashingAndVerification(t *testing.T) {
	password := "SecretPass123!"
	hash, err := security.HashPassword(password)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error hashing password: %v", err)
	}
	match, err := security.VerifyPassword(password, hash)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error verifying password: %v", err)
	}
	if !match {
		t.Fatal("expected password to match hash")
	}
	match, err = security.VerifyPassword("WrongPassword", hash)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error verifying wrong password: %v", err)
	}
	if match {
		t.Fatal("expected password not to match hash")
	}
}
func TestSessionTokenCreationAndVerification(t *testing.T) {
	secret := []byte("12345678901234567890123456789012")
	userID := uuid.New()
	ttl := time.Hour
	token, err := security.CreateSessionToken(userID, secret, ttl)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error creating session token: %v", err)
	}
	session, err := security.VerifySessionToken(token, secret)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error verifying session token: %v", err)
	}
	if session.UserID != userID {
		t.Fatalf("expected user ID %v, got %v", userID, session.UserID)
	}
	invalidSecret := []byte("different_secret_key_00000000000")
	_, err = security.VerifySessionToken(token, invalidSecret)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected verification to fail with different secret")
	}
}

package security
import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)
var ErrInvalidSession = errors.New("invalid or expired session")
type Session struct {
	UserID    uuid.UUID
	ExpiresAt time.Time
}
func CreateSessionToken(
	userID uuid.UUID,
	secret []byte,
	ttl time.Duration,
) (string, error) {
	if userID == uuid.Nil {
		return "", errors.New("user ID cannot be empty")
	}
	if len(secret) < 32 {
		return "", errors.New("session secret must be at least 32 bytes")
	}
	if ttl <= 0 {
		return "", errors.New("session lifetime must be positive")
	}
	expiresAt := time.Now().Add(ttl).Unix()
	payload := "v1:" + userID.String() + ":" + strconv.FormatInt(expiresAt, 10)
	encodedPayload := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload))
	signature := signPayload(encodedPayload, secret)
	return encodedPayload + "." + signature, nil
}
func VerifySessionToken(token string, secret []byte) (Session, error) {
	var session Session
	if len(secret) < 32 || len(token) == 0 || len(token) > 2048 {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	parts := strings.Split(token, ".")
	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	expectedSignature := signPayload(parts[0], secret)
	if !hmac.Equal(
		[]byte(parts[1]),
		[]byte(expectedSignature),
	) {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[0])
	if err != nil {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	claims := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), ":")
	if len(claims) != 3 || claims[0] != "v1" {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	userID, err := uuid.Parse(claims[1])
	if err != nil || userID == uuid.Nil {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	expiresUnix, err := strconv.ParseInt(claims[2], 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	expiresAt := time.Unix(expiresUnix, 0)
	if !time.Now().Before(expiresAt) {
		return session, ErrInvalidSession
	}
	session.UserID = userID
	session.ExpiresAt = expiresAt
	return session, nil
}
func signPayload(payload string, secret []byte) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, secret)
	_, _ = mac.Write([]byte(payload))
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}
func SessionLifetime(hours int) (time.Duration, error) {
	if hours < 1 || hours > 720 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("session lifetime must be between 1 and 720 hours")
	}
	return time.Duration(hours) * time.Hour, nil
}
func SetSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, name, token string, expiresAt time.Time, secure bool) {
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
		Name:     name,
		Value:    token,
		Path:     "/",
		Expires:  expiresAt,
		MaxAge:   int(time.Until(expiresAt).Seconds()),
		HttpOnly: true,
		Secure:   secure,
		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
	})
}
func ClearSessionCookie(w http.ResponseWriter, name string, secure bool) {
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
		Name:     name,
		Value:    "",
		Path:     "/",
		Expires:  time.Unix(0, 0),
		MaxAge:   -1,
		HttpOnly: true,
		Secure:   secure,
		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
	})
}

package middleware
import (
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"core/models"
	"core/repositories"
	"core/utils"
	"shared/security"
)
type Middleware func(http.Handler) http.Handler
func Chain(handler http.Handler, middlewares ...Middleware) http.Handler {
	for i := len(middlewares) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		handler = middlewares[i](handler)
	}
	return handler
}
func authenticate(r *http.Request, cfg utils.Config) (*models.User, int, string) {
	cookie, err := r.Cookie(cfg.SessionCookieName)
	if err != nil || cookie.Value == "" {
		return nil, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required"
	}
	session, err := security.VerifySessionToken(cookie.Value, []byte(cfg.SessionSecret))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Invalid or expired session"
	}
	db := utils.DBFromContext(r.Context(), nil)
	if db == nil {
		return nil, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Database unavailable"
	}
	userRepo := repositories.NewUserRepository(db)
	user, err := userRepo.GetUserByID(r.Context(), session.UserID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, http.StatusUnauthorized, "User not found or inactive"
	}
	user.PasswordHash = ""
	return user, http.StatusOK, ""
}
func DatabaseRoutingMiddleware(pool *utils.DBPool, cfg utils.Config) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if pool == nil {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}
			targetDB := pool.Primary
			if cfg.AllowTestDBHeader && cfg.TestDBHeaderKey != "" {
				headerVal := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get(cfg.TestDBHeaderKey))
				if strings.EqualFold(headerVal, "test") {
					targetDB = pool.Test
				}
			}
			ctx := utils.WithDB(r.Context(), targetDB)
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	}
}
func RequireAuth(cfg utils.Config) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			user, status, msg := authenticate(r, cfg)
			if status != http.StatusOK {
				utils.WriteError(w, status, msg)
				return
			}
			ctx := utils.WithUser(r.Context(), user)
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	}
}
func RequireAuthPage(cfg utils.Config) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			user, status, _ := authenticate(r, cfg)
			if status != http.StatusOK {
				http.Redirect(w, r, "/signin", http.StatusSeeOther)
				return
			}
			ctx := utils.WithUser(r.Context(), user)
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	}
}
func RequireRole(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
	for _, r := range roles {
		allowed[r] = struct{}{}
	}
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			user := utils.UserFromContext(r.Context())
			if user == nil {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
				return
			}
			if _, ok := allowed[user.RoleName]; !ok {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

	UpdatedAt    time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`

package handlers
import (
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"core/repositories"
	"core/services"
	"core/utils"
	"core/validation"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)
type LoginRequest struct {
	Email    string `json:"email" validate:"required,email"`
	Password string `json:"password" validate:"required,min=1"`
}
type SignupRequest struct {
	FirstName string `json:"first_name" validate:"required,min=1,max=50"`
	LastName  string `json:"last_name" validate:"required,min=1,max=50"`
	Email     string `json:"email" validate:"required,email,max=254"`
	Password  string `json:"password" validate:"required,min=8,max=72"`
}
type DevCreateRoleRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name" validate:"required,min=1,max=50"`
}
type DevCreateUserRequest struct {
	FirstName string `json:"first_name" validate:"required,min=1,max=50"`
	LastName  string `json:"last_name" validate:"required,min=1,max=50"`
	Email     string `json:"email" validate:"required,email,max=254"`
	Password  string `json:"password" validate:"required,min=8,max=72"`
	RoleID    string `json:"role_id"`
	RoleName  string `json:"role_name"`
}
func LoginAPIHandler(cfg utils.Config) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		var input LoginRequest
		if !utils.DecodeJSON(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(input.Email) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(input.Password) == "" {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Email and password are required")
			return
		}
		db := utils.DBFromContext(r.Context())
		if db == nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Service temporarily unavailable")
			return
		}
		userRepo := repositories.NewUserRepository(db)
		authSvc, err := services.NewAuthService(userRepo, cfg.SessionSecret, time.Duration(cfg.SessionTTLHours)*time.Hour)
		if err != nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Unable to process login")
			return
		}
		result, err := authSvc.Login(r.Context(), input.Email, input.Password)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, services.ErrInvalidCredentials) {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Invalid email or password")
				return
			}
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Unable to process login")
			return
		}
		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
			Name:     cfg.SessionCookieName,
			Value:    result.SessionToken,
			Path:     "/",
			Expires:  result.ExpiresAt,
			MaxAge:   int(time.Until(result.ExpiresAt).Seconds()),
			HttpOnly: true,
			Secure:   cfg.SessionSecure,
			SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
		})
		utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
			"message": "Login successful",
			"user":    result.User,
		})
	}
}
func SignupAPIHandler(cfg utils.Config, defaultRole ...string) http.HandlerFunc {
	targetRole := "user"
	if len(defaultRole) > 0 && defaultRole[0] != "" {
		targetRole = defaultRole[0]
	}
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		var input SignupRequest
		if !utils.DecodeJSON(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		if err := validation.ValidateStruct(input); err != nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, validation.FormatValidationError(err))
			return
		}
		db := utils.DBFromContext(r.Context())
		if db == nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Service temporarily unavailable")
			return
		}
		userRepo := repositories.NewUserRepository(db)
		roleRepo := repositories.NewRoleRepository(db)
		authSvc, err := services.NewAuthService(userRepo, cfg.SessionSecret, time.Duration(cfg.SessionTTLHours)*time.Hour)
		if err != nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Unable to finalize signup")
			return
		}
		authSvc.SetRoleRepository(roleRepo)
		role, err := roleRepo.GetRoleByName(r.Context(), targetRole)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrRoleNotFound) {
				role, err = roleRepo.CreateRole(r.Context(), targetRole)
				if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrRoleAlreadyExists) {
					role, err = roleRepo.GetRoleByName(r.Context(), targetRole)
				}
			}
			if err != nil || role == nil {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to resolve default role")
				return
			}
		}
		_, err = authSvc.CreateUser(r.Context(), services.CreateUserInput{
			FirstName: input.FirstName,
			LastName:  input.LastName,
			Email:     input.Email,
			Password:  input.Password,
			RoleID:    role.ID,
			RoleName:  targetRole,
		})
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrEmailAlreadyExists) {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Email already registered")
				return
			}
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
			return
		}
		result, err := authSvc.Login(r.Context(), input.Email, input.Password)
		if err != nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "User created but login session failed")
			return
		}
		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
			Name:     cfg.SessionCookieName,
			Value:    result.SessionToken,
			Path:     "/",
			Expires:  result.ExpiresAt,
			MaxAge:   int(time.Until(result.ExpiresAt).Seconds()),
			HttpOnly: true,
			Secure:   cfg.SessionSecure,
			SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
		})
		utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{
			"message": "User registered successfully",
			"user":    result.User,
		})
	}
}
func LogoutAPIHandler(cfg utils.Config) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
			Name:     cfg.SessionCookieName,
			Value:    "",
			Path:     "/",
			Expires:  time.Unix(0, 0),
			MaxAge:   -1,
			HttpOnly: true,
			Secure:   cfg.SessionSecure,
			SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
		})
		utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"message": "Logout successful",
		})
	}
}
func MeAPIHandler() http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		user := utils.UserFromContext(r.Context())
		if user == nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
			return
		}
		utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
			"user": user,
		})
	}
}
func DevCreateRoleHandler(cfg utils.Config) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if cfg.AppEnv == "production" {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Not found")
			return
		}
		var input DevCreateRoleRequest
		if !utils.DecodeJSON(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		input.Name = strings.TrimSpace(input.Name)
		if input.Name == "" {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Role name is required")
			return
		}
		db := utils.DBFromContext(r.Context())
		if db == nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Service temporarily unavailable")
			return
		}
		roleRepo := repositories.NewRoleRepository(db)
		role, err := roleRepo.CreateRole(r.Context(), input.Name)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrRoleAlreadyExists) {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Role already exists")
				return
			}
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
			return
		}
		utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{
			"message": "Role created successfully",
			"role":    role,
		})
	}
}
func DevCreateUserHandler(cfg utils.Config) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if cfg.AppEnv == "production" {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Not found")
			return
		}
		var input DevCreateUserRequest
		if !utils.DecodeJSON(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		input.FirstName = strings.TrimSpace(input.FirstName)
		input.LastName = strings.TrimSpace(input.LastName)
		input.Email = strings.TrimSpace(input.Email)
		input.RoleID = strings.TrimSpace(input.RoleID)
		input.RoleName = strings.TrimSpace(input.RoleName)
		if input.FirstName == "" || input.LastName == "" || input.Email == "" || input.Password == "" {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "first_name, last_name, email, and password are required")
			return
		}
		if len(input.Password) < 8 {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Password must be at least 8 characters")
			return
		}
		db := utils.DBFromContext(r.Context())
		if db == nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Service temporarily unavailable")
			return
		}
		var roleUUID uuid.UUID
		if input.RoleID != "" {
			parsedID, err := uuid.Parse(input.RoleID)
			if err != nil {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid role_id")
				return
			}
			roleRepo := repositories.NewRoleRepository(db)
			role, err := roleRepo.GetRoleByID(r.Context(), parsedID)
			if err != nil {
				if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrRoleNotFound) {
					utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Role not found")
					return
				}
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to resolve role")
				return
			}
			roleUUID = role.ID
		} else if input.RoleName == "" {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Either role_id or role_name is required")
			return
		}
		userRepo := repositories.NewUserRepository(db)
		roleRepo := repositories.NewRoleRepository(db)
		authSvc, err := services.NewAuthService(userRepo, cfg.SessionSecret, time.Duration(cfg.SessionTTLHours)*time.Hour)
		if err != nil {
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Unable to process request")
			return
		}
		authSvc.SetRoleRepository(roleRepo)
		user, err := authSvc.CreateUser(r.Context(), services.CreateUserInput{
			FirstName: input.FirstName,
			LastName:  input.LastName,
			Email:     input.Email,
			Password:  input.Password,
			RoleID:    roleUUID,
			RoleName:  input.RoleName,
		})
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrEmailAlreadyExists) {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusConflict, "Email already exists")
				return
			}
			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "not found") {
				utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
				return
			}
			utils.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
			return
		}
		utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{
			"message": "User created successfully",
			"user":    user,
		})
	}
}

package utils
import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"github.com/joho/godotenv"
)
type Config struct {
	AppEnv     string
	ServerPort string
	DBPath     string
	DBTestPath string
	AllowTestDBHeader bool
	TestDBHeaderKey   string
	SessionCookieName string
	SessionTTLHours   int
	SessionSecure     bool
	SessionSecret     string
}
var AppConfig Config
func LoadConfig() error {
	if err := godotenv.Load(); err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return fmt.Errorf("load .env: %w", err)
	}
	cfg := Config{
		AppEnv:            strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(getEnv("APP_ENV", "development"))),
		ServerPort:        strings.TrimSpace(getEnv("SERVER_PORT", "8080")),
		DBPath:            strings.TrimSpace(getEnv("DB_PATH", "app.db")),
		DBTestPath:        strings.TrimSpace(getEnv("DB_TEST_PATH", "app_test.db")),
		TestDBHeaderKey:   strings.TrimSpace(getEnv("TEST_DB_HEADER_KEY", "X-Database-Env")),
		SessionCookieName: strings.TrimSpace(getEnv("SESSION_COOKIE_NAME", "app_session")),
		SessionSecret:     os.Getenv("SESSION_SECRET"),
		SessionTTLHours:   24,
		SessionSecure:     true,
	}
	switch cfg.AppEnv {
	case "development", "test", "production":
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("APP_ENV must be development, test, or production")
	}
	if value := os.Getenv("ALLOW_TEST_DB_HEADER"); value != "" {
		allowed, err := strconv.ParseBool(strings.TrimSpace(value))
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("ALLOW_TEST_DB_HEADER must be true or false")
		}
		cfg.AllowTestDBHeader = allowed
	} else {
		cfg.AllowTestDBHeader = cfg.AppEnv != "production"
	}
	if cfg.AppEnv == "production" && cfg.AllowTestDBHeader {
		return fmt.Errorf("ALLOW_TEST_DB_HEADER cannot be enabled in production")
	}
	if value := os.Getenv("SESSION_TTL_HOURS"); value != "" {
		hours, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(value))
		if err != nil || hours < 1 || hours > 720 {
			return fmt.Errorf("SESSION_TTL_HOURS must be between 1 and 720")
		}
		cfg.SessionTTLHours = hours
	}
	if value := os.Getenv("SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE"); value != "" {
		secure, err := strconv.ParseBool(strings.TrimSpace(value))
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE must be true or false")
		}
		cfg.SessionSecure = secure
	}
	if cfg.AppEnv == "production" && !cfg.SessionSecure {
		return fmt.Errorf("SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE must be true in production")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.SessionSecret) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("SESSION_SECRET is required")
	}
	if len(cfg.SessionSecret) < 64 {
		return fmt.Errorf("SESSION_SECRET must contain at least 64 characters")
	}
	if cfg.DBPath == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("DB_PATH is required")
	}
	if cfg.DBTestPath == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("DB_TEST_PATH is required")
	}
	if cfg.DBPath == cfg.DBTestPath {
		return fmt.Errorf("DB_PATH and DB_TEST_PATH must be different")
	}
	AppConfig = cfg
	return nil
}
func getEnv(key, fallback string) string {
	value := os.Getenv(key)
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return fallback
	}
	return value
}

package utils
import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"core/db/schema"
	"github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
	_ "modernc.org/sqlite"
)
type dbContextKey struct{}
var activeDBKey = dbContextKey{}
type DBPool struct {
	Primary *sqlx.DB
	Test    *sqlx.DB
	mu      sync.RWMutex
}
func InitDBPool(cfg ...Config) (*DBPool, error) {
	activeCfg := AppConfig
	if len(cfg) > 0 {
		activeCfg = cfg[0]
	}
	if activeCfg.DBPath == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("DB_PATH is required")
	}
	primaryPath, err := filepath.Abs(activeCfg.DBPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve DB_PATH: %w", err)
	}
	testPath := activeCfg.DBTestPath
	if testPath == "" {
		testPath = "test.db"
	}
	testPathAbs, err := filepath.Abs(testPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve DB_TEST_PATH: %w", err)
	}
	if primaryPath == testPathAbs {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("test database path must never match primary database path: %s", primaryPath)
	}
	primaryDB, err := OpenDB(primaryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open primary database: %w", err)
	}
	testDB, err := OpenDB(testPathAbs)
	if err != nil {
		_ = primaryDB.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open test database: %w", err)
	}
	return &DBPool{
		Primary: primaryDB,
		Test:    testDB,
	}, nil
}
func OpenDB(path string) (*sqlx.DB, error) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create database directory: %w", err)
	}
	dsn := fmt.Sprintf("file:%s?_pragma=busy_timeout(5000)&_pragma=foreign_keys(ON)&_pragma=journal_mode(WAL)&_pragma=synchronous(NORMAL)", path)
	db, err := sqlx.Open("sqlite", dsn)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open sqlite: %w", err)
	}
	db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	db.SetMaxIdleConns(1)
	if err := db.Ping(); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("ping sqlite: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := db.Exec(schema.SchemaSQL); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("apply schema: %w", err)
	}
	return db, nil
}
func (p *DBPool) Close() error {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	var firstErr error
	if p.Primary != nil {
		if err := p.Primary.Close(); err != nil && firstErr == nil {
			firstErr = err
		}
	}
	if p.Test != nil {
		if err := p.Test.Close(); err != nil && firstErr == nil {
			firstErr = err
		}
	}
	return firstErr
}
func WithDB(ctx context.Context, db *sqlx.DB) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, activeDBKey, db)
}
func DBFromContext(ctx context.Context, fallback ...*sqlx.DB) *sqlx.DB {
	if ctx != nil {
		if db, ok := ctx.Value(activeDBKey).(*sqlx.DB); ok && db != nil {
			return db
		}
	}
	if len(fallback) > 0 {
		return fallback[0]
	}
	return nil
}

package utils
import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"github.com/goccy/go-json"
)
type ErrorResponse struct {
	Error string `json:"error"`
}
func WriteJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	if data == nil {
		return
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(data)
}
func WriteError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, message string) {
	WriteJSON(w, status, ErrorResponse{Error: message})
}
func DecodeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, dst any) bool {
	if r.Body == nil {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Request body is required")
		return false
	}
	defer r.Body.Close()
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
	if err := decoder.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Request body is required")
			return false
		}
		WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid JSON payload")
		return false
	}
	return true
}

package services
import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"core/cache"
	"core/models"
	"core/repositories"
	"shared/security"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)
var (
	ErrInvalidCredentials = errors.New("invalid email or password")
	ErrInvalidAuthConfig  = errors.New("invalid authentication configuration")
)
type AuthService struct {
	users     *repositories.UserRepository
	roles     *repositories.RoleRepository
	secret    []byte
	ttl       time.Duration
	userCache *cache.MemoryCache[*models.User]
}
type LoginResult struct {
	User         *models.User
	SessionToken string
	ExpiresAt    time.Time
}
type CreateUserInput struct {
	FirstName string
	LastName  string
	Email     string
	Password  string
	RoleID    uuid.UUID
	RoleName  string
}
func NewAuthService(
	users *repositories.UserRepository,
	sessionSecret string,
	sessionTTL time.Duration,
) (*AuthService, error) {
	if users == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: user repository is required", ErrInvalidAuthConfig)
	}
	secret := strings.TrimSpace(sessionSecret)
	if secret == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: session secret cannot be empty", ErrInvalidAuthConfig)
	}
	if len(secret) < 32 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: session secret must contain at least 32 bytes", ErrInvalidAuthConfig)
	}
	if sessionTTL <= 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: session TTL must be positive", ErrInvalidAuthConfig)
	}
	return &AuthService{
		users:     users,
		secret:    []byte(secret),
		ttl:       sessionTTL,
		userCache: cache.NewMemoryCache[*models.User](),
	}, nil
}
func (s *AuthService) SetRoleRepository(roles *repositories.RoleRepository) {
	s.roles = roles
}
func (s *AuthService) CreateUser(ctx context.Context, input CreateUserInput) (*models.User, error) {
	if s == nil || s.users == nil {
		return nil, ErrInvalidAuthConfig
	}
	input.FirstName = strings.TrimSpace(input.FirstName)
	input.LastName = strings.TrimSpace(input.LastName)
	input.Email = strings.TrimSpace(input.Email)
	if input.FirstName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("first name is required")
	}
	if input.LastName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("last name is required")
	}
	if input.Email == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("email is required")
	}
	if len(input.Password) < 8 {
		return nil, errors.New("password must be at least 8 characters")
	}
	var roleID uuid.UUID
	if input.RoleID != uuid.Nil {
		roleID = input.RoleID
	} else if input.RoleName != "" && s.roles != nil {
		role, err := s.roles.GetRoleByName(ctx, input.RoleName)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrRoleNotFound) {
				role, err = s.roles.CreateRole(ctx, input.RoleName)
				if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrRoleAlreadyExists) {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("create role: %w", err)
				}
				if role == nil {
					role, err = s.roles.GetRoleByName(ctx, input.RoleName)
					if err != nil {
						return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve role: %w", err)
					}
				}
			} else {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("get role: %w", err)
			}
		}
		roleID = role.ID
	} else {
		return nil, errors.New("valid role ID or role name is required")
	}
	hashedPassword, err := security.HashPassword(input.Password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("hash password: %w", err)
	}
	newUserID, err := uuid.NewV7()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generate user ID: %w", err)
	}
	user := &models.User{
		ID:           newUserID,
		FirstName:    input.FirstName,
		LastName:     input.LastName,
		Email:        input.Email,
		PasswordHash: hashedPassword,
		RoleID:       roleID,
	}
	if err := s.users.CreateUser(ctx, user); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	createdUser, err := s.users.GetUserByID(ctx, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		user.PasswordHash = ""
		return user, nil
	}
	createdUser.PasswordHash = ""
	return createdUser, nil
}
func (s *AuthService) Login(
	ctx context.Context,
	email string,
	password string,
) (*LoginResult, error) {
	if s == nil || s.users == nil {
		return nil, ErrInvalidAuthConfig
	}
	email = strings.TrimSpace(email)
	if email == "" || password == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
	}
	user, err := s.users.GetUserByEmail(ctx, email)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, repositories.ErrUserNotFound) {
			return nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("retrieve user for authentication: %w", err)
	}
	passwordMatches, err := security.VerifyPassword(password, user.PasswordHash)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify stored password hash: %w", err)
	}
	if !passwordMatches {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
	}
	token, err := security.CreateSessionToken(user.ID, s.secret, s.ttl)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create session token: %w", err)
	}
	expiresAt := time.Now().Add(s.ttl)
	expiresAt = time.Unix(expiresAt.Unix(), 0)
	user.PasswordHash = ""
	s.userCache.Set(user.ID.String(), user, s.ttl)
	return &LoginResult{
		User:         user,
		SessionToken: token,
		ExpiresAt:    expiresAt,
	}, nil
}
func (s *AuthService) VerifySession(token string) (security.Session, error) {
	if s == nil || len(s.secret) < 32 {
		return security.Session{}, ErrInvalidAuthConfig
	}
	return security.VerifySessionToken(token, s.secret)
}
func (s *AuthService) UserIDFromSession(token string) (uuid.UUID, error) {
	session, err := s.VerifySession(token)
	if err != nil {
		return uuid.Nil, err
	}
	return session.UserID, nil
}
func (s *AuthService) ValidateSession(ctx context.Context, token string) (*models.User, error) {
	userID, err := s.UserIDFromSession(token)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if cachedUser, ok := s.userCache.Get(userID.String()); ok {
		return cachedUser, nil
	}
	user, err := s.users.GetUserByID(ctx, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	user.PasswordHash = ""
	s.userCache.Set(userID.String(), user, s.ttl)
	return user, nil
}
=== FILE: /home/desktop/especa/beta/projects/core/cache/cache.go ===
package cache
import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)
type item[T any] struct {
	value     T
	expiresAt time.Time
}
type MemoryCache[T any] struct {
	mu    sync.RWMutex
	items map[string]item[T]
}
func NewMemoryCache[T any]() *MemoryCache[T] {
	return &MemoryCache[T]{
		items: make(map[string]item[T]),
	}
}
func (c *MemoryCache[T]) Get(key string) (T, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	it, found := c.items[key]
	c.mu.RUnlock()
	if !found {
		var zero T
		return zero, false
	}
	if time.Now().After(it.expiresAt) {
		c.mu.Lock()
		delete(c.items, key)
		c.mu.Unlock()
		var zero T
		return zero, false
	}
	return it.value, true
}
func (c *MemoryCache[T]) Set(key string, value T, ttl time.Duration) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.items[key] = item[T]{
		value:     value,
		expiresAt: time.Now().Add(ttl),
	}
}
func (c *MemoryCache[T]) Delete(key string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	delete(c.items, key)
}

		}

	}

		t.Errorf("user ID = %v, want %v", result.User.ID, expectedUser.ID)

	}

package tests
import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"shared/security"
)
func TestHashPasswordAndVerify(t *testing.T) {
	password := "Example-Password-123"
	hash, err := security.HashPassword(password)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("HashPassword returned an error: %v", err)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(hash, "$argon2id$v=19$") {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected hash format: %q", hash)
	}
	matches, err := security.VerifyPassword(password, hash)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("VerifyPassword returned an error: %v", err)
	}
	if !matches {
		t.Fatal("correct password was rejected")
	}
	matches, err = security.VerifyPassword("Wrong-Password-123", hash)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("VerifyPassword returned an error: %v", err)
	}
	if matches {
		t.Fatal("incorrect password was accepted")
	}
}

	t.Cleanup(func() {

			t.Errorf("close SQLite database: %v", err)
		}

		t.Fatalf("enable foreign keys: %v", err)

		}
		if _, err := db.Exec(string(schema)); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("execute schema %s: %v", schemaFile, err)

				PasswordHash: "hash",

				LastName:     "User",
				Email:        "test@example.com",
				PasswordHash: "hash",
			},
		},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if err := repo.CreateUser(ctx, tt.user); err == nil {
				t.Error("CreateUser() expected an error for invalid input")
			}
		})
	}

package tests
import (
	"testing"
	"time"
	"shared/security"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)
func TestSessionTokenRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	secret := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
	userID := uuid.New()
	token, err := security.CreateSessionToken(userID, secret, time.Hour)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CreateSessionToken failed: %v", err)
	}
	session, err := security.VerifySessionToken(token, secret)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("VerifySessionToken failed: %v", err)
	}
	if session.UserID != userID {
		t.Fatalf("expected user ID %s, got %s", userID, session.UserID)
	}
	if !session.ExpiresAt.After(time.Now()) {
		t.Fatal("expected session expiration to be in the future")
	}
}
func TestSessionTokenRejectsTampering(t *testing.T) {
	secret := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
	token, err := security.CreateSessionToken(uuid.New(), secret, time.Hour)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	token += "tampered"
	if _, err := security.VerifySessionToken(token, secret); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected tampered token to be rejected")
	}
}
func TestSessionTokenRejectsWrongSecret(t *testing.T) {
	secret := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
	wrongSecret := []byte("abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789")
	token, err := security.CreateSessionToken(uuid.New(), secret, time.Hour)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := security.VerifySessionToken(token, wrongSecret); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected token signed with another secret to be rejected")
	}
}
func TestSessionTokenRejectsMalformedToken(t *testing.T) {
	secret := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
	if _, err := security.VerifySessionToken("not-a-valid-token", secret); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected malformed token to be rejected")
	}
}
func TestCreateSessionTokenRejectsInvalidInput(t *testing.T) {
	secret := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
	if _, err := security.CreateSessionToken(uuid.Nil, secret, time.Hour); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected nil UUID to be rejected")
	}
	if _, err := security.CreateSessionToken(uuid.New(), secret, 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected non-positive TTL to be rejected")
	}
	if _, err := security.CreateSessionToken(uuid.New(), []byte("short"), time.Hour); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected short secret to be rejected")
	}
}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roles (
	id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
	name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
	deleted_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT chk_roles_id_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0),
	CONSTRAINT chk_roles_name_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
	id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
	first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
	last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
	email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
	role_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
	deleted_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT fk_users_role FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	CONSTRAINT chk_users_id_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0),
	CONSTRAINT chk_users_first_name_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(first_name)) > 0),
	CONSTRAINT chk_users_last_name_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(last_name)) > 0),
	CONSTRAINT chk_users_email_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(email)) > 0),
	CONSTRAINT chk_users_password_hash_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(password_hash)) > 0),
	CONSTRAINT chk_users_role_id_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(role_id)) > 0)
);

package sqlc
import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
)
type DBTX interface {
	ExecContext(context.Context, string, ...interface{}) (sql.Result, error)
	PrepareContext(context.Context, string) (*sql.Stmt, error)
	QueryContext(context.Context, string, ...interface{}) (*sql.Rows, error)
	QueryRowContext(context.Context, string, ...interface{}) *sql.Row
}
func New(db DBTX) *Queries {
	return &Queries{db: db}
}
type Queries struct {
	db DBTX
}
func (q *Queries) WithTx(tx *sql.Tx) *Queries {
	return &Queries{
		db: tx,
	}
}

package sqlc
import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
)
const createRole = `-- name: CreateRole :exec
INSERT INTO roles (id, name)
VALUES (?, ?)
`
type CreateRoleParams struct {
	ID   string `json:"id"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
}
func (q *Queries) CreateRole(ctx context.Context, arg CreateRoleParams) error {
	_, err := q.db.ExecContext(ctx, createRole, arg.ID, arg.Name)
	return err
}
const createUser = `-- name: CreateUser :exec
INSERT INTO users (
	id,
	first_name,
	last_name,
	email,
	password_hash,
	role_id
)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
`
type CreateUserParams struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	FirstName    string `json:"first_name"`
	LastName     string `json:"last_name"`
	Email        string `json:"email"`
	PasswordHash string `json:"password_hash"`
	RoleID       string `json:"role_id"`
}
func (q *Queries) CreateUser(ctx context.Context, arg CreateUserParams) error {
	_, err := q.db.ExecContext(ctx, createUser,
		arg.ID,
		arg.FirstName,
		arg.LastName,
		arg.Email,
		arg.PasswordHash,
		arg.RoleID,
	)
	return err
}
const getRoleByID = `-- name: GetRoleByID :one
SELECT id, name, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
FROM roles
WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
LIMIT 1
`
func (q *Queries) GetRoleByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (Role, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, getRoleByID, id)
	var i Role
	err := row.Scan(
		&i.ID,
		&i.Name,
		&i.CreatedAt,
		&i.UpdatedAt,
		&i.DeletedAt,
	)
	return i, err
}
const getRoleByName = `-- name: GetRoleByName :one
SELECT id, name, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
FROM roles
WHERE name = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
LIMIT 1
`
func (q *Queries) GetRoleByName(ctx context.Context, name string) (Role, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, getRoleByName, name)
	var i Role
	err := row.Scan(
		&i.ID,
		&i.Name,
		&i.CreatedAt,
		&i.UpdatedAt,
		&i.DeletedAt,
	)
	return i, err
}

package repositories
import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"core/db/sqlc"
	"core/models"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
)
var (
	ErrUserNotFound       = errors.New("user not found")
	ErrEmailAlreadyExists = errors.New("email already exists")
	ErrRoleNotFound       = errors.New("role not found")
	ErrRoleAlreadyExists  = errors.New("role already exists")
)
type RoleRepository struct {
	q *sqlc.Queries
}
func NewRoleRepository(db *sqlx.DB) *RoleRepository {
	return &RoleRepository{q: sqlc.New(db.DB)}
}
func (r *RoleRepository) CreateRole(ctx context.Context, name string) (*models.Role, error) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" || len(name) > 50 {
		return nil, errors.New("role name must be between 1 and 50 bytes")
	}
	id, err := uuid.NewV7()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generate role id: %w", err)
	}
	err = r.q.CreateRole(ctx, sqlc.CreateRoleParams{
		ID:   id.String(),
		Name: name,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "unique") {
			return nil, ErrRoleAlreadyExists
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create role: %w", err)
	}
	return r.GetRoleByID(ctx, id)
}
func (r *RoleRepository) GetRoleByID(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*models.Role, error) {
	if id == uuid.Nil {
		return nil, ErrRoleNotFound
	}
	row, err := r.q.GetRoleByID(ctx, id.String())
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return nil, ErrRoleNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get role by id: %w", err)
	}
	return mapRole(row.ID, row.Name, row.CreatedAt, row.UpdatedAt, row.DeletedAt)
}
func (r *RoleRepository) GetRoleByName(ctx context.Context, name string) (*models.Role, error) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" {
		return nil, ErrRoleNotFound
	}
	row, err := r.q.GetRoleByName(ctx, name)
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return nil, ErrRoleNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get role by name: %w", err)
	}
	return mapRole(row.ID, row.Name, row.CreatedAt, row.UpdatedAt, row.DeletedAt)
}
type UserRepository struct {
	q *sqlc.Queries
}
func NewUserRepository(db *sqlx.DB) *UserRepository {
	return &UserRepository{q: sqlc.New(db.DB)}
}
func (r *UserRepository) CreateUser(ctx context.Context, user *models.User) error {
	if user == nil {
		return errors.New("user cannot be nil")
	}
	user.FirstName = strings.TrimSpace(user.FirstName)
	user.LastName = strings.TrimSpace(user.LastName)
	user.Email = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(user.Email))
	if user.FirstName == "" || len(user.FirstName) > 50 {
		return errors.New("first name must be between 1 and 50 bytes")
	}
	if user.LastName == "" || len(user.LastName) > 50 {
		return errors.New("last name must be between 1 and 50 bytes")
	}
	if user.Email == "" || len(user.Email) > 254 {
		return errors.New("email must be between 1 and 254 bytes")
	}
	if user.PasswordHash == "" || len(user.PasswordHash) > 255 {
		return errors.New("password hash must be between 1 and 255 bytes")
	}
	if user.RoleID == uuid.Nil {
		return errors.New("role ID is required")
	}
	if user.ID == uuid.Nil {
		id, err := uuid.NewV7()
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("generate user id: %w", err)
		}
		user.ID = id
	}
	err := r.q.CreateUser(ctx, sqlc.CreateUserParams{
		ID:           user.ID.String(),
		FirstName:    user.FirstName,
		LastName:     user.LastName,
		Email:        user.Email,
		PasswordHash: user.PasswordHash,
		RoleID:       user.RoleID.String(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "unique constraint failed") {
			return ErrEmailAlreadyExists
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("create user: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}
func (r *UserRepository) GetUserByEmail(ctx context.Context, email string) (*models.User, error) {
	email = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(email))
	row, err := r.q.GetUserByEmail(ctx, email)
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return nil, ErrUserNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get user by email: %w", err)
	}
	return mapUser(row.ID, row.FirstName, row.LastName, row.Email, row.PasswordHash, row.RoleID, row.RoleName, row.CreatedAt, row.UpdatedAt, row.DeletedAt)
}
func (r *UserRepository) GetUserByID(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*models.User, error) {
	if id == uuid.Nil {
		return nil, ErrUserNotFound
	}
	row, err := r.q.GetUserByID(ctx, id.String())
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return nil, ErrUserNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get user by id: %w", err)
	}
	return mapUser(row.ID, row.FirstName, row.LastName, row.Email, row.PasswordHash, row.RoleID, row.RoleName, row.CreatedAt, row.UpdatedAt, row.DeletedAt)
}
func mapRole(idStr, name, createdStr, updatedStr string, deletedStr sql.NullString) (*models.Role, error) {
	id, err := uuid.Parse(idStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse role id: %w", err)
	}
	createdAt, err := parseSQLiteTime(createdStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse role created_at: %w", err)
	}
	updatedAt, err := parseSQLiteTime(updatedStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse role updated_at: %w", err)
	}
	role := &models.Role{
		ID:        id,
		Name:      name,
		CreatedAt: createdAt,
		UpdatedAt: updatedAt,
	}
	if deletedStr.Valid && deletedStr.String != "" {
		t, err := parseSQLiteTime(deletedStr.String)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse role deleted_at: %w", err)
		}
		role.DeletedAt = &t
	}
	return role, nil
}
func mapUser(idStr, firstName, lastName, email, pwdHash, roleIDStr, roleName, createdStr, updatedStr string, deletedStr sql.NullString) (*models.User, error) {
	id, err := uuid.Parse(idStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse user id: %w", err)
	}
	roleID, err := uuid.Parse(roleIDStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse user role_id: %w", err)
	}
	createdAt, err := parseSQLiteTime(createdStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse user created_at: %w", err)
	}
	updatedAt, err := parseSQLiteTime(updatedStr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse user updated_at: %w", err)
	}
	user := &models.User{
		ID:           id,
		FirstName:    firstName,
		LastName:     lastName,
		Email:        email,
		PasswordHash: pwdHash,
		RoleID:       roleID,
		RoleName:     roleName,
		CreatedAt:    createdAt,
		UpdatedAt:    updatedAt,
	}
	if deletedStr.Valid && deletedStr.String != "" {
		t, err := parseSQLiteTime(deletedStr.String)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse user deleted_at: %w", err)
		}
		user.DeletedAt = &t
	}
	return user, nil
}
func parseSQLiteTime(value string) (time.Time, error) {
	layouts := []string{
		time.RFC3339Nano,
		"2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999-07:00",
		"2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999",
		"2006-01-02 15:04:05",
	}
	for _, layout := range layouts {
		if parsed, err := time.Parse(layout, value); err == nil {
			return parsed, nil
		}
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported SQLite timestamp %q", value)
}

package validation
import (
	"strings"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)
var validate = validator.New()
func ValidateStruct(s any) error {
	return validate.Struct(s)
}
func FormatValidationError(err error) string {
	if err == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if valErrs, ok := err.(validator.ValidationErrors); ok {
		var messages []string
		for _, e := range valErrs {
			field := e.Field()
			switch e.Tag() {
			case "required":
				messages = append(messages, field+" is required")
			case "email":
				messages = append(messages, field+" must be a valid email address")
			case "min":
				messages = append(messages, field+" must be at least "+e.Param()+" characters")
			case "max":
				messages = append(messages, field+" must be at most "+e.Param()+" characters")
			default:
				messages = append(messages, field+" failed validation on "+e.Tag())
			}
		}
		return strings.Join(messages, ", ")
	}
	return err.Error()
}

package routes
import (
	"net/http"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	coreHandlers "core/handlers"
	"core/middleware"
	"core/utils"
)
func RegisterBackendRoutes(
	r *chi.Mux,
	pool *utils.DBPool,
	cfg utils.Config,
) {
	r.Get("/api/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		db := utils.DBFromContext(req.Context(), pool.Primary)
		if db == nil {
			utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
				"status": "unavailable",
				"db":     "disconnected",
			})
			return
		}
		if err := db.PingContext(req.Context()); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "Database unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
			return
		}
		dbName := "primary"
		if db == pool.Test {
			dbName = "test"
		}
		utils.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"status": "ok",
			"db":     "connected",
			"target": dbName,
		})
	})
	r.Route("/api/auth", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Post("/login", coreHandlers.LoginAPIHandler(cfg))
		r.Post("/signup", coreHandlers.SignupAPIHandler(cfg))
		r.Post("/logout", coreHandlers.LogoutAPIHandler(cfg))
		r.With(middleware.RequireAuth(cfg)).Get("/me", coreHandlers.MeAPIHandler())
	})
	r.Route("/api/dev", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Post("/roles", coreHandlers.DevCreateRoleHandler(cfg))
		r.Post("/users", coreHandlers.DevCreateUserHandler(cfg))
	})
}

import (
	"net/http"
	"core/middleware"
)
type Middleware = middleware.Middleware
func Chain(h http.Handler, middlewares ...Middleware) http.Handler {
	return middleware.Chain(h, middlewares...)
}
=== FILE: /home/desktop/especa/beta/projects/photography_crm/routes/router.go ===
package routes
import (
	"net/http"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"chi-mysql-server/handlers"
	"core/middleware"
	"core/utils"
)
func SetupRouter(pool *utils.DBPool, cfg utils.Config) http.Handler {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.MethodNotAllowed(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		handlers.NotFoundHandler(w, req)
	})
	r.NotFound(handlers.NotFoundHandler)
	r.Use(middleware.DatabaseRoutingMiddleware(pool, cfg))
	RegisterFrontendRoutes(r, cfg)
	RegisterBackendRoutes(r, pool, cfg)
	return r
}

package static
import (
	"embed"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
)
//go:embed css js
var staticFS embed.FS
func FS() http.FileSystem {
	sub, err := fs.Sub(staticFS, ".")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return http.FS(sub)
}

=== FILE: /home/desktop/especa/beta/projects/photography_crm/ui/static/js/auth.js ===
(function () {
	const STORAGE_KEY = 'crm_user';
	window.CRMAuth = {
	getUser() {
	try {
		const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
		return data ? JSON.parse(data) : null;
	} catch (e) {
		return null;
	}
	},
	setUser(user) {
	if (!user) {
		localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
	} else {
		localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
	}
	},
	clearUser() {
	localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
	},
	async login(email, password) {
	const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
		method: 'POST',
		headers: {
		'Content-Type': 'application/json',
		},
		body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
	});
	const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
	if (!response.ok) {
		throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to sign in');
	}
	if (data.user) {
		this.setUser(data.user);
	}
	return data;
	},
	async signup(firstName, lastName, email, password) {
	const response = await fetch('/api/auth/signup', {
		method: 'POST',
		headers: {
		'Content-Type': 'application/json',
		},
		body: JSON.stringify({
		first_name: firstName,
		last_name: lastName,
		email: email,
		password: password,
		}),
	});
	const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
	if (!response.ok) {
		throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to create account');
	}
	if (data.user) {
		this.setUser(data.user);
	}
	return data;
	},
	async logout() {
	try {
		await fetch('/api/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' });
	} finally {
		this.clearUser();
		window.location.href = '/signin';
	}
	},
	async checkMe() {
	try {
		const response = await fetch('/api/auth/me');
		if (response.ok) {
		const data = await response.json();
		if (data.user) {
			this.setUser(data.user);
			return data.user;
		}
		} else {
		this.clearUser();
		return null;
		}
	} catch (e) {
		return null;
	}
	}
	};
})();

	const columns = board.querySelectorAll(columnSelector);
	const instances = [];
	columns.forEach(col => {
		const sortable = new Sortable(col, {
			group: groupName,
			animation: 150,
			ghostClass: 'crm-kanban-ghost',
			chosenClass: 'crm-kanban-chosen',
			dragClass: 'crm-kanban-dragging',
			handle: options.handle || undefined,
			onEnd: function(evt) {
				const itemEl = evt.item;
				const toColumn = evt.to;
				const fromColumn = evt.from;
				const itemId = itemEl.getAttribute('data-id') || itemEl.id;
				const toColId = toColumn.getAttribute('data-col-id') || toColumn.id.replace('kanban-items-', '');
				const fromColId = fromColumn.getAttribute('data-col-id') || fromColumn.id.replace('kanban-items-', '');
				const newIndex = evt.newIndex;
				updateColumnBadges(fromColumn, toColumn);
				const customEvent = new CustomEvent('kanban:cardMoved', {
					bubbles: true,
					detail: {
						itemId,
						toColId,
						fromColId,
						newIndex,
						itemEl,
						toColumn,
						fromColumn
					}
				});
				board.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
				const endpoint = postUrl || itemEl.getAttribute('hx-post') || toColumn.getAttribute('data-post-url');
				if (endpoint && window.htmx) {
					window.htmx.ajax('POST', endpoint, {
						values: {
							id: itemId,
							to_stage: toColId,
							from_stage: fromColId,
							position: newIndex
						},
						swap: 'none'
					});
				}
			}
		});
		instances.push(sortable);
	});
	function updateColumnBadges(fromCol, toCol) {
		[fromCol, toCol].forEach(col => {
			if (!col) return;
			const parentCol = col.closest('.crm-kanban-column');
			if (!parentCol) return;
			const badge = parentCol.querySelector('.crm-kanban-column-count');
			if (badge) {
				const count = col.querySelectorAll('.crm-kanban-card').length;
				badge.textContent = count;
			}
		});
	}
	return instances;
};

	document.querySelectorAll('.crm-kanban-board').forEach(board => {
		window.initKanbanBoard(board);
	});

			if description != "" {
				<p class="crm-page-desc">{ description }</p>

		</div>
		<div class="crm-page-actions">
			{ children... }
		</div>
	</div>
}
templ StatCard(label string, value string, trend string, isUp bool, icon string) {
	@components.Card("crm-stat-card") {
		<div class="crm-stat-header">
			<span class="crm-stat-label">{ label }</span>
			<span class="crm-stat-icon">
				if icon == "👥" || icon == "users" {
					@components.IconUsers()
				} else if icon == "✨" || icon == "sparkles" {
					@components.IconSparkles()
				} else if icon == "🎯" || icon == "target" {
					@components.IconTarget()
				} else if icon == "📁" || icon == "folder" {
					@components.IconFolder()
				} else if icon == "📷" || icon == "camera" {
					@components.IconCamera()
				} else if icon == "💰" || icon == "💵" || icon == "💎" || icon == "dollar" {
					@components.IconDollarSign()
				} else if icon == "⏳" || icon == "clock" {
					@components.IconClock()
				} else if icon == "📈" || icon == "trending-up" {
					@components.IconTrendingUp()
				} else if icon == "📊" || icon == "chart" {
					@components.IconBarChart3()
				} else if icon == "🆕" || icon == "user-plus" {
					@components.IconUserPlus()
				} else {
					<span>{ icon }</span>
				}
			</span>
		</div>
		<div class="crm-stat-value">{ value }</div>
		if trend != "" {
			<div class={ "crm-stat-trend", templ.KV("trend-up", isUp), templ.KV("trend-down", !isUp) }>
				if isUp {
					<span>↑ { trend }</span>
				} else {
					<span>↓ { trend }</span>
				}
			</div>
		}
	}
}
templ StatusPill(label string, color string) {
	@components.Badge(components.BadgeProps{Variant: color}) {
		{ label }
	}
}

templ Pagination(page int, totalPages int, totalItems int) {
	<div class="crm-pagination">
		<span class="crm-pagination-info">Showing <span class="crm-pagination-count">1</span> to <span class="crm-pagination-count">{ fmt.Sprintf("%d", totalItems) }</span> of <span class="crm-pagination-count">{ fmt.Sprintf("%d", totalItems) }</span> entries</span>
		<div class="crm-pagination-controls">
			<button class="crm-page-btn crm-page-nav" disabled aria-label="Previous page">
				@components.IconChevronLeft()
				<span>Previous</span>
			</button>
			<div class="crm-pagination-pages">
				<button class="crm-page-btn is-active" aria-current="page">1</button>
				if totalPages > 1 {
					<button class="crm-page-btn">2</button>
				}
				if totalPages > 2 {
					<button class="crm-page-btn">3</button>
				}
			</div>
			<button class="crm-page-btn crm-page-nav" disabled?={ totalPages <= 1 } aria-label="Next page">

			</button>
		</div>
	</div>
}

						const root = document.getElementById('spotlight-search-root');
						const box = document.getElementById('spotlight-box');
						const input = document.getElementById('spotlight-input');
						const clearBtn = document.getElementById('spotlight-clear-btn');
						const itemsContainer = document.getElementById('spotlight-items');
						if (!root || !box || !input) return;
						function openSpotlight() {
							root.style.display = 'flex';
							input.value = '';
							updateState();
							setTimeout(() => {
								input.focus();
							}, 50);
						}
						function closeSpotlight() {
							root.style.display = 'none';
							box.classList.remove('is-shrunk', 'is-expanded');
						}
						function updateState() {
							const hasValue = input.value.trim().length > 0;
							if (hasValue) {
								box.classList.remove('is-shrunk');
								box.classList.add('is-expanded');
								clearBtn.classList.add('is-active');
								filterItems(input.value.trim().toLowerCase());
							} else {
								box.classList.remove('is-expanded');
								clearBtn.classList.remove('is-active');
								resetItems();
							}
						}
						function filterItems(query) {
							if (!itemsContainer) return;
							const items = itemsContainer.querySelectorAll('.spotlight-item');
							let first = true;
							items.forEach(item => {
								const title = (item.getAttribute('data-title') || '').toLowerCase();
								const cat = (item.getAttribute('data-category') || '').toLowerCase();
								const desc = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
								if (title.includes(query) || cat.includes(query) || desc.includes(query)) {
									item.style.display = 'flex';
									if (first) {
										item.classList.add('is-selected');
										first = false;
									} else {
										item.classList.remove('is-selected');
									}
								} else {
									item.style.display = 'none';
									item.classList.remove('is-selected');
								}
							});
						}
						function resetItems() {
							if (!itemsContainer) return;
							const items = itemsContainer.querySelectorAll('.spotlight-item');
							items.forEach((item, idx) => {
								item.style.display = 'flex';
								if (idx === 0) item.classList.add('is-selected');
								else item.classList.remove('is-selected');
							});
						}
						let mouseMoveTimeout;
						window.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
							if (root.style.display !== 'flex') return;
							if (input.value.trim().length === 0) {
								box.classList.add('is-shrunk');
								clearTimeout(mouseMoveTimeout);
								mouseMoveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {}, 500);
							}
						});
						input.addEventListener('focus', function() {
							if (input.value.trim().length === 0) {
								box.classList.remove('is-shrunk');
							}
						});
						input.addEventListener('input', function() {
							updateState();
						});
						clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
							input.value = '';
							updateState();
							input.focus();
						});
						document.querySelectorAll('.spotlight-trigger-btn').forEach(btn => {
							btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
								e.preventDefault();
								e.stopPropagation();
								openSpotlight();
							});
						});
						document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
							if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K')) {
								e.preventDefault();
								if (root.style.display === 'flex') {
									closeSpotlight();
								} else {
									openSpotlight();
								}
								return;
							}
							if (e.key === '/' && !['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName)) {
								e.preventDefault();
								openSpotlight();
								return;
							}
							if (root.style.display !== 'flex') return;
							if (e.key === 'Escape') {
								e.preventDefault();
								closeSpotlight();
							} else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
								e.preventDefault();
								const visibleItems = Array.from(itemsContainer.querySelectorAll('.spotlight-item')).filter(el => el.style.display !== 'none');
								if (visibleItems.length === 0) return;
								let currentIndex = visibleItems.findIndex(el => el.classList.contains('is-selected'));
								if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
									currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % visibleItems.length;
								} else {
									currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + visibleItems.length) % visibleItems.length;
								}
								visibleItems.forEach((el, idx) => {
									if (idx === currentIndex) {
										el.classList.add('is-selected');
										el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
									} else {
										el.classList.remove('is-selected');
									}
								});
							} else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
								const selected = itemsContainer.querySelector('.spotlight-item.is-selected');
								if (selected) {
									e.preventDefault();
									selected.click();
								}
							}
						});
						root.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
							if (!box.contains(e.target)) {
								closeSpotlight();
							}
						});
					})();

				}
				<h3 class="crm-kanban-column-title">{ col.Title }</h3>
				if col.Badge != "" {
					<span class="crm-kanban-column-count">{ col.Badge }</span>
				}
			</div>
			if col.HeaderAction != nil {
				<div class="crm-kanban-column-actions">
					@col.HeaderAction
				</div>
			} else {
				<div class="crm-kanban-column-actions" style="color: var(--text-dim); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
					@components.IconMoreHorizontal()
					@components.IconPlus()
				</div>
			}
		</div>
		<div class="crm-kanban-column-body" id={ "kanban-items-" + col.ID } data-col-id={ col.ID }>
			{ children... }
		</div>
		<div class="crm-kanban-column-footer">
			<button class="crm-kanban-add-card-btn">
				@components.IconPlus()
				<span>Add Task</span>
			</button>

	</div>

templ SignIn() {
	@layouts.AuthLayout("Sign In - Aperture CRM") {
		<div class="auth-header">
			<h1 class="auth-title">Welcome back</h1>
			<p class="auth-subtitle">Sign in to your photography studio account</p>
		</div>
		<form class="auth-form" id="signin-form" method="POST" action="/signin">
			<div id="auth-error" style="display: none; color: #ff6b6b; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.1); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.2);"></div>
			<div class="form-group">
				<label class="form-label" for="email">Email</label>
				<input class="form-input" id="email" name="email" type="email" placeholder="photographer@studio.com" required/>
			</div>
			<div class="form-group">
				<div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
					<label class="form-label" for="password">Password</label>
					<a href="/forgot-password" class="auth-link" style="font-size: 11px;">Forgot password?</a>
				</div>
				<input class="form-input" id="password" name="password" type="password" placeholder="••••••••" required/>
			</div>
			@components.Button("Sign In", "c-btn-primary")
		</form>
		<script>
			document.getElementById('signin-form').addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
				e.preventDefault();
				const errorDiv = document.getElementById('auth-error');
				errorDiv.style.display = 'none';
				const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
				const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
				try {
					await window.CRMAuth.login(email, password);
					window.location.href = '/';
				} catch (err) {
					errorDiv.textContent = err.message || 'Login failed';
					errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
				}
			});
		</script>
		<div class="auth-footer">
			Don't have an account? <a href="/signup" class="auth-link">Create an account</a>
		</div>
	}
}

templ SignUp() {
	@layouts.AuthLayout("Sign Up - Aperture CRM") {
		<div class="auth-header">
			<h1 class="auth-title">Create an account</h1>
			<p class="auth-subtitle">Set up your studio and start managing clients</p>
		</div>
		<form class="auth-form" id="signup-form" method="POST" action="/signup">
			<div id="signup-error" style="display: none; color: #ff6b6b; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.1); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.2);"></div>
			<div style="display: flex; gap: 12px;">
				<div class="form-group" style="flex: 1;">
					<label class="form-label" for="first_name">First Name</label>
					<input class="form-input" id="first_name" name="first_name" type="text" placeholder="John" required/>
				</div>
				<div class="form-group" style="flex: 1;">
					<label class="form-label" for="last_name">Last Name</label>
					<input class="form-input" id="last_name" name="last_name" type="text" placeholder="Doe" required/>
				</div>
			</div>
			<div class="form-group">
				<label class="form-label" for="email">Email</label>
				<input class="form-input" id="email" name="email" type="email" placeholder="photographer@studio.com" required/>
			</div>
			<div class="form-group">
				<label class="form-label" for="password">Password</label>
				<input class="form-input" id="password" name="password" type="password" placeholder="Create a password (min 8 chars)" required/>
			</div>
			@components.Button("Create Account", "c-btn-primary")
		</form>
		<script>
			document.getElementById('signup-form').addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
				e.preventDefault();
				const errorDiv = document.getElementById('signup-error');
				errorDiv.style.display = 'none';
				const firstName = document.getElementById('first_name').value.trim();
				const lastName = document.getElementById('last_name').value.trim();
				const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
				const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
				try {
					await window.CRMAuth.signup(firstName, lastName, email, password);
					window.location.href = '/';
				} catch (err) {
					errorDiv.textContent = err.message || 'Registration failed';
					errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
				}
			});
		</script>
		<div class="auth-footer">
			Already have an account? <a href="/signin" class="auth-link">Sign in</a>
		</div>
	}
}

			function setStatus(status) {
				const label = document.getElementById('current-status-text');
				if (label) label.textContent = status;
				const menu = document.getElementById('status-menu');
				if (menu) {
					menu.classList.remove('show');
					menu.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item').forEach(el => {
						if (el.textContent.trim() === status) el.classList.add('active');
						else el.classList.remove('active');
					});
				}
			}
			function setStage(stage) {
				const label = document.getElementById('current-stage-text');
				if (label) label.textContent = stage;
				const menu = document.getElementById('stage-menu');
				if (menu) {
					menu.classList.remove('show');
					menu.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item').forEach(el => {
						if (el.textContent.trim() === stage) el.classList.add('active');
						else el.classList.remove('active');
					});
				}
			}
			window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				const statusMenu = document.getElementById('status-menu');
				const stageMenu = document.getElementById('stage-menu');
				if (statusMenu && !e.target.closest('#status-selector-container')) {
					statusMenu.classList.remove('show');
				}
				if (stageMenu && !e.target.closest('#stage-selector-container')) {
					stageMenu.classList.remove('show');
				}
			});
		</script>
	}

			function exportDataCSV() {
				const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#cancelled-main-table tr'));

				const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
				const a = document.createElement('a');
				a.href = url;
				a.download = 'cancelled-transactions.csv';
				a.click();

			function toggleColumnsDropdown(e) {
				e.stopPropagation();
				const menu = document.getElementById('edit-columns-popover');
				if (menu) menu.classList.toggle('is-open');
			}
			function toggleExpenseFilters() {
				const wrap = document.getElementById('expense-filter-input-wrap');
				if (wrap) {
					wrap.style.display = wrap.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
					if (wrap.style.display === 'block') wrap.querySelector('input')?.focus();
				}
			}
			function filterExpensesTable(val) {
				const term = val.toLowerCase();
				const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#expenses-main-table tbody tr');
				rows.forEach(row => {
					row.style.display = row.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(term) ? '' : 'none';
				});
			}
			function exportDataCSV() {
				const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#expenses-main-table tr'));
				const csv = rows.map(r => Array.from(r.children).map(c => '"' + c.innerText.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"').join(',')).join('\\n');
				const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
				const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
				const a = document.createElement('a');
				a.href = url;
				a.download = 'expenses.csv';
				a.click();
			}
		</script>
	}

			function toggleColumnsDropdown(e) {
				e.stopPropagation();
				const menu = document.getElementById('edit-columns-popover');
				if (menu) menu.classList.toggle('is-open');
			}
			function toggleInvoiceFilters() {
				const wrap = document.getElementById('invoice-filter-input-wrap');
				if (wrap) {
					wrap.style.display = wrap.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
					if (wrap.style.display === 'block') wrap.querySelector('input')?.focus();
				}
			}
			function filterInvoicesTable(val) {
				const term = val.toLowerCase();
				const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#invoices-main-table tbody tr');
				rows.forEach(row => {
					row.style.display = row.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(term) ? '' : 'none';
				});
			}
			function exportDataCSV() {
				const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#invoices-main-table tr'));
				const csv = rows.map(r => Array.from(r.children).map(c => '"' + c.innerText.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"').join(',')).join('\\n');
				const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
				const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
				const a = document.createElement('a');
				a.href = url;
				a.download = 'invoices.csv';
				a.click();
			}
			function openInvoiceModal(id, client, amount) {
				const modal = document.getElementById('invoice-modal');
				if (!modal) return;
				if (id) document.getElementById('invoice-modal-id').innerText = '# ' + id;
				if (client) {
					document.getElementById('modal-client-name').value = client;
					document.getElementById('modal-invoice-name').value = 'Invoice - ' + client + ' Wedding';
					document.getElementById('modal-project-name').value = client + ' Wedding';
				}
				modal.classList.add('is-open');
			}
			function closeInvoiceModal() {
				document.getElementById('invoice-modal')?.classList.remove('is-open');
			}
			document.getElementById('invoice-modal')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				if (e.target === this) closeInvoiceModal();
			});
		</script>
	}
}
