		<script>
			function toggleColumnsDropdown(e) {
				e.stopPropagation();
				const menu = document.getElementById('edit-columns-popover');
				if (menu) menu.classList.toggle('is-open');
			}
			function togglePaymentFilters() {
				const wrap = document.getElementById('payment-filter-input-wrap');
				if (wrap) {
					wrap.style.display = wrap.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
					if (wrap.style.display === 'block') {
						wrap.querySelector('input')?.focus();
					}
				}
			}
			function filterPaymentsTable(val) {
				const term = val.toLowerCase();
				const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#payments-main-table tbody tr');
				rows.forEach(row => {
					row.style.display = row.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(term) ? '' : 'none';
				});
			}
			function filterColumnList(val) {
				const term = val.toLowerCase();
				const items = document.querySelectorAll('#column-checkbox-list .column-item');
				items.forEach(item => {
					item.style.display = item.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(term) ? 'flex' : 'none';
				});
			}
			function clearColumnsSelection() {
				const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#column-checkbox-list input[type="checkbox"]');
				checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = false);
				updateColumnsCount();
			}
			function updateColumnsCount() {
				const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#column-checkbox-list input[type="checkbox"]');
				let checkedCount = 0;
				checkboxes.forEach(cb => { if (cb.checked) checkedCount++; });
				const countEl = document.getElementById('columns-selected-count');
				if (countEl) countEl.innerText = checkedCount + ' Selected';
			}
			function applyColumnsSelection() {
				const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#column-checkbox-list input[type="checkbox"]');
				checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
					const colClass = cb.getAttribute('data-col');
					const els = document.querySelectorAll('.' + colClass);
					els.forEach(el => {
						el.style.display = cb.checked ? '' : 'none';
					});
				});
				document.getElementById('edit-columns-popover')?.classList.remove('is-open');
			}
			document.querySelectorAll('#column-checkbox-list input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(cb => {
				cb.addEventListener('change', updateColumnsCount);
			});
			document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				const menu = document.getElementById('edit-columns-popover');
				if (menu && !menu.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('.billing-icon-btn')) {
					menu.classList.remove('is-open');
				}
			});
			function exportDataCSV() {
				const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#payments-main-table tr'));
				const csv = rows.map(r => Array.from(r.children).map(c => '"' + c.innerText.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"').join(',')).join('\\n');
				const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
				const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
				const a = document.createElement('a');
				a.href = url;
				a.download = 'payments-ledger.csv';
				a.click();
			}
			function openInvoiceModal(id, client, amount) {
				const modal = document.getElementById('invoice-modal');
				if (!modal) return;
				if (id) {
					document.getElementById('invoice-modal-id').innerText = '# ' + id;
				}
				if (client) {
					document.getElementById('modal-client-name').value = client;
					document.getElementById('modal-invoice-name').value = 'Invoice - ' + client + ' Wedding';
					document.getElementById('modal-project-name').value = client + ' Wedding';
				}
				modal.classList.add('is-open');
			}
			function closeInvoiceModal() {
				document.getElementById('invoice-modal')?.classList.remove('is-open');
			}
			document.getElementById('invoice-modal')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				if (e.target === this) {
					closeInvoiceModal();
				}
			});
		</script>
	}

				const titleInput = document.getElementById("event-title");

				const title = document.getElementById("event-title").value.trim();

				const date = document.getElementById("event-date").value;
				const time = document.getElementById("event-time").value;
				const duration = parseInt(document.getElementById("event-duration").value, 10);
				const meetUrl = document.getElementById("event-meet-link").value.trim();
				if (!title || !date || !time) {
					alert("Please provide event title, date, and time.");
					return;

				const start = new Date(`${date}T${time}:00`);
				const end = new Date(start.getTime() + duration * 60000);
				let className = "fc-event-meet";
				if (type === "busy") className = "fc-event-busy";
				if (type === "session") className = "fc-event-session";

						title: title,
						start: start.toISOString(),

			function filterCalendarEvents() {
				const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll(".calendar-filter-checkbox");
				const enabledCategories = new Set();
				checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
					if (cb.checked) enabledCategories.add(cb.getAttribute("data-filter"));
				});
				if (!calendar) return;
				calendar.getEvents().forEach(evt => {
					const cat = evt.extendedProps?.category;
					if (!cat || enabledCategories.has(cat)) {
						evt.setProp("display", "auto");
					} else {
						evt.setProp("display", "none");
					}
				});

func getUpcomingBorderColor(isBusy bool) string {
	if isBusy {
		return "#ff7675"
	}
	return "var(--accent-primary)"

func getUpcomingBorderColor(isBusy bool) string {
	if isBusy {

	}
	return "var(--accent-primary)"

			<script>
				function updateSeqPreview(key) {
					const input = document.getElementById('seq-' + key + '-input');
					const preview = document.getElementById('seq-' + key + '-preview');
					if (!input || !preview) return;
					let pattern = input.value;
					const now = new Date();
					const yyyy = now.getFullYear();
					const yy = String(yyyy).slice(-2);
					const mm = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
					let rendered = pattern
						.replace('{YYYY}', yyyy)
						.replace('{YY}', yy)
						.replace('{MM}', mm)
						.replace('{SEQ:4}', '0042')
						.replace('{SEQ:3}', '042')
						.replace('{SEQ:5}', '00042');
					preview.textContent = rendered;
				}
				function resetToDefaults() {
					if (confirm("Reset all sequence rules back to factory defaults?")) {
						document.getElementById('seq-lead-input').value = "LEAD-{YYYY}-{SEQ:4}";
						document.getElementById('seq-client-input').value = "CLI-{SEQ:4}";
						document.getElementById('seq-project-input').value = "PRJ-{YY}-{SEQ:3}";
						document.getElementById('seq-order-input').value = "ORD-{YYYY}-{SEQ:3}";
						document.getElementById('seq-invoice-input').value = "INV-{YYYY}-{MM}-{SEQ:4}";
						document.getElementById('seq-contract-input').value = "CTR-{YYYY}-{SEQ:4}";
						['lead', 'client', 'project', 'order', 'invoice', 'contract'].forEach(updateSeqPreview);
					}
				}
			</script>
		}
	}

package main
import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"chi-mysql-server/routes"
	"core/utils"
)
func main() {
	if err := utils.LoadConfig(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	cfg := utils.AppConfig
	pool, err := utils.InitDBPool(cfg)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	router := routes.SetupRouter(pool, cfg)
	serverPort := cfg.ServerPort
	fmt.Println("http://localhost:" + serverPort)
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":"+serverPort, router); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
=== FILE: /home/desktop/especa/beta/cmd/runner/main.go ===
package main
import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"syscall"
	"time"
	crmRoutes "chi-mysql-server/routes"
	cmsRoutes "cms/routes"
	"core/utils"
	"github.com/joho/godotenv"
	superadminRoutes "superadmin/routes"
)
type ServiceApp struct {
	Name    string
	Port    string
	DBPath  string
	Pool    *utils.DBPool
	Server  *http.Server
}
func main() {
	_ = godotenv.Load()
	apps := []struct {
		name          string
		portEnv       string
		defaultPort   string
		dbEnv         string
		defaultDB     string
		cookieName    string
		routerBuilder func(pool *utils.DBPool, cfg utils.Config) http.Handler
	}{
		{
			name:          "CMS",
			portEnv:       "CMS_PORT",
			defaultPort:   "8081",
			dbEnv:         "CMS_DB_PATH",
			defaultDB:     "cms.db",
			cookieName:    "cms_session",
			routerBuilder: cmsRoutes.SetupRouter,
		},
		{
			name:          "Photography CRM",
			portEnv:       "CRM_PORT",
			defaultPort:   "8082",
			dbEnv:         "CRM_DB_PATH",
			defaultDB:     "photography_crm.db",
			cookieName:    "photography_session",
			routerBuilder: crmRoutes.SetupRouter,
		},
		{
			name:          "Superadmin",
			portEnv:       "SUPERADMIN_PORT",
			defaultPort:   "8083",
			dbEnv:         "SUPERADMIN_DB_PATH",
			defaultDB:     "superadmin.db",
			cookieName:    "superadmin_session",
			routerBuilder: superadminRoutes.SetupRouter,
		},
	}
	sessionSecret := os.Getenv("SESSION_SECRET")
	if sessionSecret == "" {
		sessionSecret = "0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123"
	}
	appEnv := os.Getenv("APP_ENV")
	if appEnv == "" {
		appEnv = "development"
	}
	activeServices := make([]*ServiceApp, 0, len(apps))
	defer func() {
		for _, s := range activeServices {
			if s.Pool != nil {
				_ = s.Pool.Close()
			}
		}
	}()
	for _, a := range apps {
		port := getEnv(a.portEnv, a.defaultPort)
		dbPath := getEnv(a.dbEnv, a.defaultDB)
		dbTestPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(dbPath), "test_"+filepath.Base(dbPath))
		cfg := utils.Config{
			AppEnv:            appEnv,
			ServerPort:        port,
			DBPath:            dbPath,
			DBTestPath:        dbTestPath,
			AllowTestDBHeader: appEnv != "production",
			TestDBHeaderKey:   "X-Database-Env",
			SessionCookieName: a.cookieName,
			SessionSecret:     sessionSecret,
			SessionTTLHours:   24,
			SessionSecure:     appEnv == "production",
		}
		pool, err := utils.InitDBPool(cfg)
		if err != nil {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("[%s] DB initialization failed: %v", a.name, err))
		}
		router := a.routerBuilder(pool, cfg)
		server := &http.Server{
			Addr:    ":" + port,
			Handler: router,
		}
		service := &ServiceApp{
			Name:   a.name,
			Port:   port,
			DBPath: dbPath,
			Pool:   pool,
			Server: server,
		}
		activeServices = append(activeServices, service)
	}
	for _, s := range activeServices {
		go func(srv *ServiceApp) {
			fmt.Printf("➜ [%s] listening on http://localhost:%s (db: %s)\n", srv.Name, srv.Port, srv.DBPath)
			if err := srv.Server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
				fmt.Printf("[%s] server error: %v\n", srv.Name, err)
			}
		}(s)
	}
	quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-quit
	fmt.Println("\nShutting down multi-listener servers...")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	for _, s := range activeServices {
		if err := s.Server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[%s] shutdown error: %v\n", s.Name, err)
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("All services stopped.")
}
func getEnv(key, fallback string) string {
	if val := os.Getenv(key); val != "" {
		return val
	}
	return fallback
}
